pages.text: TM-035 Supplement GOAL IV Operation, Maintenance and Service Manual Amended Table Top Assembly Drawing For those owning the Goal Iv game with all four control knobs located on the table top instead of on the base: The enclosed Atari drawing #A003870 and parts list #003870 reflect this changed con- figuration. Please use these materials as aids in servicing the Goal IV game, top-knob version. This drawing and parts list replace those printed in the Goal IV manual, name- ly #A003838 Bar--Top Assembly. No electrical changes have been made to the game with this knob placement modification. ATARI INC 14600 WINCHESTER BOULEVARD, LOS GATOS, CALIFORNIA 95030 * TELEPHONE (408) 374-2440 » TELEX 367-488
